# Agent quote

An agent wrote this quote with bare `>` lines between its paragraphs:

> First paragraph of the quote, written by an agent.
>
> Second paragraph, after a bare marker line.
>
> Third paragraph.

The same with `> ` (a space) between paragraphs:

> First paragraph.
> 
> Second paragraph.

In a list:

- An item with a quote
	> Quoted under the item.
	>
	> And after a bare line.
